title: 4. Aggregation & Grouping
description: Analyze payroll by department. Calculate the average salary per department.
objective: Select department and the average salary (aliased as avg_salary) from Employees grouped by department.
targetQuery: SELECT department, AVG(salary) AS avg_salary FROM Employees GROUP BY department;
